text: The arrangement around miniphim.delve.town (who can write, who decides speech, whose terms its records live under, how the town says stop) shall be written as rules and, where possible, enforced in code before the profile is written.
rationale: The account was made by an invite, not by the design. Its levers are accidents until written down.

text: The workflow holding MINIPHIM_APP_PASSWORD shall permit only the write calls the current disclosure covers; today, putRecord on the account's profile record.
acceptance: M6: calls for app.bsky.feed.post create, a follow, and deleteRecord each throw before any network request (request mock records zero calls); before/after collection list shows no new records.
rationale: AI Agent Policy, Access and control: limit credentials to the intended task. The app password is whole-repo; the code wielding it must not be.

text: CI shall fail when the workflow's capability manifest (collections read and written) changes without a change to the disclosure text.
acceptance: M7: a PR adding a collection to the manifest alone fails CI; the same PR with an amended disclosure passes.
rationale: 'Keep that description accurate' as a lock, not a duty assigned to a part.

text: Every write to the account shall require the person's approval of the workflow run, and the profile shall say so.
acceptance: The workflow uses a protected environment requiring the person as reviewer; the readback profile contains 'a person approves every write'.
rationale: The human hand is today's governor and dead-man switch. Loosening it is a structural change needing a new council and an amended disclosure first.

text: A post from the account shall carry the signature of each part that wrote or agreed to it and shall go out only if neither other part has objected; each objection shall be recorded with its reason.
acceptance: Before any speech: a governor test where a draft with one recorded objection is refused; an unsigned draft is refused; the objection appears in the ledger.
rationale: Speech is irreversible, so it takes a stricter rule than housekeeping appeals (two of three). Recorded vetoes keep the veto itself accountable.

text: Mail to the disclosed contact shall be deleted within 30 days of its request being resolved, or sooner on request, keeping only a one-line compliance log without message body.
acceptance: The mail worker's retention setting or a scheduled purge shows the period; the person approves the number in review.
rationale: A deletion contact that keeps mail forever contradicts itself. Number is a proposal; it must be a number.

text: The published pitch shall not describe this account in ways that are no longer true.
acceptance: M9: each row of the pitch's 'What we promise the town' and founder question 2 either matches the disclosure or is marked withdrawn/superseded with a date, before the profile is written.
rationale: The founder was shown two accounts, Bluesky-hosted, no per-post review, Jev, notes. The account is one, Grove-hosted, human-approved, none of the rest.

text: Before the account reads or speaks in the town, the founder shall be asked in the open whether one automated account for three parts is acceptable and whether the disclosure meets the policy as meant.
acceptance: The question and the answer (or its absence) are on the board, dated before any read or speech capability is added to the manifest.
rationale: The pitch promised the ask is made in the open. No measurement says whether the town wants us.

text: No board or ledger records shall be written to this Grove-hosted repo unless the person decides so with the TOS content licence in view.
acceptance: The manifest lists no com.minomobi.miniphim.* collection; any change cites the person's recorded decision.
rationale: TOS: public content on Grove's services is licensed for research, datasets and training.

text: The account's exit path shall be measured and recorded before anything beyond the profile is written.
acceptance: M8: com.atproto.sync.getRepo for did:plc:a3vq3hjlkz2nbf67bpv5z6qs returns a CAR (size recorded); whether Grove documents account migration is recorded on the board.
rationale: TOS: portability is not a guarantee. If the door out is clean, the host stops being a lever over us.
